data.rationale: The proposal follows the same core steps in the right order (origin, destination by country and airport, date navigation, passengers, search, select outbound and return), but it leaves out choosing a fare type and the optional passenger-details/booking step, and it lists promo code as a parameter without giving a step for entering it.
